scope: One new entry hypothesis; allocation-free research, no orders. All existing history is reused exploration.
hypothesis: Temporary selling pressure within an established uptrend may reverse; require recovery above prior high. Price alone does not identify news-driven selling.
entry: D close: C[D-3]>SMA20[D-3]>SMA60[D-3]; C[D-1]<C[D-2]<C[D-3]; C[D]>H[D-1]; C[D]>SMA60[D]. Enter next session open.
shortlist: Existing liquid_top20, reconstructed with D-available data. 63 consecutive valid sessions needed for this hypothesis; historical current-status restrictions cannot be reconstructed.
control: Same signal date and market, same liquid shortlist and trend conditions C[D-3]>SMA20[D-3]>SMA60[D-3], C[D]>SMA60[D], irrespective of pullback/recovery. Includes signal stocks. Same next-open entry, five holding sessions, costs and eligibility.
aggregation: Compute signal and control mean within date-market; combine market edges weighted by observed signal counts, then equal-weight dates. Also report each market, trade means, nonoverlap and missing/uncertain counts. Never account returns.
boundaries: Exclude events whose scheduled entry+5-session exit exceeds a period. Do not turn incomplete/missing returns into zero. Same date-market comparison uses only observed outcomes with denominators and exclusions preserved.
fill_uncertainty: Zero-volume/single-price next-day bars are retrospective fill_unverifiable, not proof of a known pre-open cancellation. Show separately; no automatic adoption when execution evidence is missing.
nonoverlap_unknown: If entry or holding state is data_unknown or fill_unverifiable, block later same-symbol entries for that period in the nonoverlap diagnostic; preserve every original signal event.

uncertainty.method: Moving calendar-session blocks, preserving no-signal sessions; finite date edges only in each resample.

research_gate.criteria: Both development and validation: net and market-matched edge >0 at both costs; both markets basic-cost edge>0 and >=10 signal days; nonoverlap mean>0; no mature unknown data; validation basic-cost CI lower>0. This is a research-candidate gate only, not adoption.
research_gate.on_failure: unadopted; no parameter/market retuning on these results; retain frozen hypothesis for explicitly labelled observation

forward.criteria: At the fixed final checkpoint only: both-cost prospective net and matched edge>0; basic-cost CI lower>0; >=60 closed events over >=30 signal days; each market>=10 signal days and positive edge; nonoverlap net>0; unresolved data/execution issues reviewed. Insufficient evidence stays unadopted. No automatic order enablement.
forward.schedule_limit: Competition runs 2026-10-12 through 2026-11-20. Pre-competition Oct9 review is diagnostics only; enough prospective evidence is not promised by the start or end. Do not keep extending the sample until a pass.
forward.clock: Only sessions completed after frozen_at with signal sealed before the next session opening qualify. Old bars are bootstrap; delayed creation is late. Never rewrite sealed signals.

source_limits: Grimes provides structural inspiration; SMA lengths, two-day pullback, close confirmation and five-day hold are our unvalidated operational definition. US monthly reversal research does not establish Korean daily profitability. Existing fixed-universe, revision and survival limitations remain. One current hypothesis does not erase previous multiple trials.
